kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From مَرْقَعَ (marqaʕa) of the root م ر ق ع (m r q ʕ).
s: م ر ق ع (m r q ʕ)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: تَمَرْقَعَ • (tamarqaʕa) IIq (non-past يَتَمَرْقَعُ (yatamarqaʕu), verbal noun تَمَرْقُع (tamarquʕ))
g: to party hearty, to do reckless things

ince.merkez_mana: to be wild, to be frivolous, to be light-headed
